basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old graduate student based in Toronto, Canada. I recently got into gaming and technology in my spare time, which explains my current interest in how things work. I work part-time at a local bookstore and am in a long-distance relationship. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, when I'm not juggling school and work. I dislike overly complex tech jargon and prefer straightforward solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I have a basic understanding of tech and gaming setups, but I often rely on community advice to fill in gaps. I have a background in English Literature, which has honed my research skills, but I'm a novice in technical applications.
